national_news.title: PM Modi Highlights Anti-Naxal Security Success in Bastar Visit
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi visited the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) camp at Karanpur in Bastar, Chhattisgarh, celebrating Diwali with security personnel.
Highlighted that for the first time in 47 years, not a single CRPF jawan lost their life on duty over the past year, marking major progress against Left Wing Extremism (LWE).
Noted the reduction of Naxal influence across India from a peak of over 230 districts in 20 states, alongside broader socioeconomic progress.

national_news.title: Defence Minister Highlights 'Second Tour of Duty' for Agniveers at Bagdogra
bullets: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh addressed IAF personnel at Air Force Station Bagdogra, West Bengal, calling for operational readiness against asymmetric warfare, cyber threats, and drone swarms.
Highlighted Cabinet approval for the 'Second Tour of Duty' initiative, allowing eligible Agniveers to be enrolled as regular soldiers after completing their two-year engagement.
Reiterated support for 'Aatmanirbhar Bharat' in defense, emphasizing the integration of indigenous startup innovations in anti-drone and cybersecurity systems.

national_news.title: Petroleum Ministry Reaffirms E20 Petrol Compliance with BIS Standards
bullets: The Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas confirmed that E20 petrol supplied by public sector Oil Marketing Companies (IOCL, BPCL, HPCL) adheres to BIS specification IS 17021.
Quality tests conducted on 893 samples across 27 States and Union Territories confirmed ethanol blending strictly within the prescribed 19% to 20% range.
The Ministry addressed quality concerns raised by state authorities, confirming strict quality assurance protocols across national distribution networks.

national_news.title: Prime Minister Highlights Major Milestones in Counter-LWE Operations
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi celebrated Diwali with security personnel at the CRPF camp in Karanpur, Bastar (Chhattisgarh), highlighting national progress against Left Wing Extremism (LWE).
For the first time in 47 years, no CRPF jawan lost their life on duty in the past year, marking a shift from peak LWE influence across 230+ districts in 20 states.
Acknowledged the contributions of CRPF, CoBRA, BSF, ITBP, SSB, Bastar Fighters, and women commandos in eradicating Naxal violence and lifting 50 crore citizens out of extreme poverty.

bihar_news.title: Bihar to Launch Drive for Voluntary Surrender of Electricity Subsidy
bullets: The Bihar state government announced a campaign starting December 1, 2026, to encourage affluent families to voluntarily give up their electricity subsidy.
Under the state's free power initiative, 1.92 crore families currently receive 125 units of free electricity.
The state government provides an estimated subsidy worth approximately Rs 10,000 annually per family.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Announces 83-km Ganga Riverfront Road Connecting Munger and Bhagalpur
bullets: The Bihar government has announced the construction of an 83-km Ganga riverfront road connecting Munger and Bhagalpur to boost regional transport and economic development along the river corridor.
The announcement was made during the Munger Deepotsav at Kalyanpur in Bariarpur block, Munger district, where over 11.11 lakh (11,11,111) lamps were lit.
The project aims to improve transport connectivity, manage seasonal flooding challenges along the Ganga river basin, and support the state's broader initiative to curb out-migration by 2030.
